# Repository Skill File Convention

Repository-scoped skills follow the existing convention used under `.agents/skills/`.

Each skill is stored as a single `SKILL.md` file with only `name` and `description` in its frontmatter.

Each `SKILL.md` must remain at or below 300 lines.

Skills distill reusable principles and workflows from source material. They do not copy a supplied instruction document into a multi-file reference bundle.

Do not add `agents/openai.yaml`, references, scripts, or assets unless a future repository convention explicitly requires them.
